id.description: Must equal the file name without .json

edition.description: Year or cycle the values were taken from

pageLimit.description: Main-body page limit; null = no limit

referencesPageLimit.description: Extra pages allowed for references only

requireAllEmbedded.description: true = even Base-14 fonts must be embedded

cfpUrl.description: Official call for papers / author guidelines (https), or empty

unverified.description: Field names whose values have NOT been checked against the official CFP

lastChecked.description: ISO date when a contributor last verified the values
